notes.title: Taimumari five-year anniversary and update to Definitive Edition
notes.content:
[img]https://cdn.cloudflare.steamstatic.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/25363761/02592ac56fab21f3686b5c2c9deb0925525258ea.jpg[/img]
On December 16, 2015 I released my first commercial game - [b]Taimumari[/b]. It was not a perfect and polished game, but it was my dream. With Taimumari I was able to leave my office work and realize my projects.

And today, five years later, the game gets a major upgrade, straight from the consoles. I hope you will be pleased with the new graphics in the dialogues. If you wish, you can also play the classic version. https://store.steampowered.com/app/375520
The new Definitive Edition also includes an addition with Kanashimi, which now does not need to be purchased separately.

I am also developing Taimumari 2 and unfortunately I was not able to release it by the fifth anniversary as planned. There's still a lot of work to do, so I don't know when I can release it yet. https://store.steampowered.com/app/1292400
However, my small BakuMari project will be released soon - you can check out its Steam page now. https://store.steampowered.com/app/1470880/BakuMari
I appreciate your support and hope that you will also play my future games. [b]Thank you all![/b]

notes.title: Big update, Free Demo and Sale!
notes.content:
The first post-release major update for Nexoria is here! In this update combat system has been seriously changed, as well as multiple edits to the balance, a new mode, a new hero, and movement in the dungeon has become more user-friendly.

[h2]Improvements in Battle Mode:[/h2]
1. Characters in battle are now placed in invisible cells. Half of the cells are given to heroes, and half to enemies.
2. The cells are free to move in. Heroes have six cells, and characters are four. So you can move forward, move backwards, and you don't have to replace the hero.
3. Now, for a melee attack, the character will come to the front line. Thus, not only one character will take almost all the damage, you need to think about melee and long range combat.
4. Moving between cells now does not end the turn! Yes, you can step back and use the card. However, since the attack automatically uses moving to the first line, if you move to any other cell than first one, you will not be able to attack in close combat on this turn.

[h2]New mode and demo version[/h2]
Now there's a one-level "quick play" dungeon mode, made especially for the demo version, but it's also perfect if you want to check something or test a new hero. Yes, now there is a demo version with the "quick play" mode! Also the demo version doesn't offer all the heroes, but it is a great way to learn the game.

[h2]New Hero[/h2]
Because of the new battle system, the game needs to pick long-range heroes. So welcome Archer! Her attack is completely long-range and does not require any movement. 

[h2]Dungeon upgrades[/h2]
Many cells in the dungeons are now marked with an icon. You can see where your enemies are, where your treasure is, and where random events are. However, this will not save you from some traps or some random events that cannot be foreseen.

Stay with me, there's more to come!

notes.title: Update 0.4 ~Balance changes~
notes.content:
New update for you to be more interesting!

[h1]Changes in battles[/h1]
Battles take up a lot of time, and that's not bad for a roguelike. However, when one battle takes several tens of minutes to cast a monotonous attacks, it becomes boring. I've read people's feedback and made some important changes in the combat process.

[b]The amount of health of heroes and enemies is reduced.[/b]
Now every HP counts, and attacks become more dangerous, as well as spells. Any strike can be fatal, so keep an eye on your opponents' weaknesses. This has resulted in a rebalancing of spells and treatment potions, which now restore less health.

[b]Mana points are now given more often, once a second. [/b]
This allows you to cast spells more often than ever before, and not just to use default attacks endlessly. However, keep in mind that enemies can now use spells more often as well. 

[b]Animation of the attack is accelerated. [/b]
People have asked for a fast-track option, but I have decided that the attack animation should be accelerated in general, not only in the fast-track mode. You can still speed up the fight even more by holding down Ctrl.

[h1]Changes in dungeon[/h1]
The research mode also has its own problems, and I would like to answer the frequent question: "Why are the needs being wasted, even if the heroes are just pushing against the wall? The answer is simple - I would like to make players more thoughtful about their movements, and trying to memorize the map, or even sketch it, so as not to bump into walls and previously visited places. Do not  try to get to the end as quickly as possible. This game is not about rushing. And now about the update:

[b]Changed the chances of getting some events in the dungeon.[/b]
It so happens that although I have added a lot of new events, they were hardly noticed, because the chance of their falling out was extremely small. I fixed it and added a couple of new events to make you have more fun. You can even find a robot from IN-VERT, I hope you can do it.

In addition, various bugs were also fixed, for example, when deleting each item gave you a point of knowledge. Points should only be given for removing spells.

Thank you to everyone who plays and tests the game, thanks to you it will be more interesting and fun to release.
